title: A Human-LLM Teaming Framework for Privacy Risk Analysis: An Illustration with CBDC-Based Welfare Schemes
abstract: arXiv:2608.16461v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC)-based welfare schemes may be potentially privacy invasive as they process significant volumes of beneficiary personal data and lead to privacy harms such as surveillance, discrimination and stigmatization. Such welfare delivery schemes involve complex digital ecosystems and large number of stakeholders. Consequently, to examine their privacy risks, privacy risk assessments require extensive information gathering and synthesis, complex reasoning, scenario explorations, contextual evaluation and human judgement. Thus, they present ideal scenarios for human-LLM teaming, where effective integration of complementary human and LLM capabilities can yield an outcome far superior to either human-only or LLM-only assessments. In this paper, we propose a first human-LLM teaming framework for the systematic privacy risk analysis methodology called PRIAM. The framework specifies an iterative collaborative proces

translated_title: 一种用于隐私风险分析的人机协作框架：以CBDC福利计划为例
translated_abstract: 基于央行数字货币（CBDC）的福利计划可能具有潜在的隐私侵犯性，因为它们处理大量受益人的个人数据，并可能导致监视、歧视和污名化等隐私危害。此类福利发放计划涉及复杂的数字生态系统和大量利益相关者。因此，为了审查其隐私风险，隐私风险评估需要广泛的信息收集与综合、复杂推理、情景探索、情境评估和人类判断。这使得它们成为人机协作的理想场景，在这种协作中，人类与LLM能力的有效整合可以产生远优于仅人类或仅LLM评估的结果。在本文中，我们提出了首个用于系统性隐私风险分析方法论PRIAM的人机协作框架。该框架规定了一个迭代的协作过程。
tldr: 本文提出了首个将人类与大型语言模型协作的系统性框架，用于分析CBDC福利计划中的隐私风险，显著提升了评估的全面性和准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first human-LLM teaming framework for systematic privacy risk analysis of CBDC-based welfare schemes, enhancing assessment comprehensiveness and accuracy.
